title: HWMON_DIR is not found for Dell platform causes crash in determine-reboot-cause
author: vaibhavhd
body:

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

At the time of reboot, `HWMON_DIR` is not found for Dell platform which causes the `determine-reboot-cause` script to crash unexpectedly.

Failing line of code:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-dell/s6100/sonic_platform/fan.py#L26

`No such file or directory: '/sys/devices/platform/SMF.512/hwmon/`

However, the DIR is present:

```
root@str-s6100-acs-4:~# ls /sys/devices/platform/SMF.512/hwmon/
hwmon1
root@str-s6100-acs-4:~#
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Install latest SONiC master image on Arista device. I hit the issue in 508
2. Check output of `show reboot-cause`. The reboot cause is either not detected or printed from an old reboot cause.
3. Issue is seen in syslog at the beginning stage where DUT is booting into the new image.

Install latest SONiC master image on Arista device. I hit the issue in 500
Issue is seen in syslog at the beginning stage where DUT is booting into the new image.

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body: @ArunSaravananBalachandran tagging you as this seems to be DELL platform library issue.

comments.author: ArunSaravananBalachandran
comments.body:
The mentioned error is seen because the platform APIs are called before the platform initialization is complete.For `process-reboot-cause`, there is a [systemd rule](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-dell/s6100/systemd/s6100-reboot-cause.service#L3) to prevent this, but the issue is seen since a new `determine-reboot-cause` service is used.
We will work on the fix.

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body: Hi @ArunSaravananBalachandran, do you have an ETA for this fix? Thanks.

comments.author: ArunSaravananBalachandran
comments.body: @vaibhavhd, will raise a PR by end of next week

**- Why I did it**

To ensure platform initialization is complete before `determine-reboot-cause.service` executes. 
resolves #6082 

**- How I did it**

Added a systemd rule to make platform-modules service as a prerequisite for determine-reboot-cause service. 

**- How to verify it**

Verify determine-reboot-cause.service is executed and reset reason is updated.
Logs: [UT_logs.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5753901/UT_logs.txt)
